Locations in South Dakota ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} county_coverage <- if (d$n_arrests > 0) sum(d$county_counts$n) / d$n_arrests else 0 state_map_sf <- tryCatch({ sf::st_as_sf( maps::map("county", state_lower, fill = TRUE, plot = FALSE) ) |> mutate(county = str_to_title(str_remove(ID, paste0(state_lower, ",")))) }, error = function(e) NULL) if (!is.null(state_map_sf) && nrow(d$county_counts) > 0 && county_coverage >= 0.20) { county_sf <- state_map_sf |> left_join(d$county_counts, by = "county") |> replace_na(list(n = 0)) |> mutate( n_map = if_else(n <= 1, NA_real_, as.double(n)), label = paste0("", county, " County
Arrests: ", n) ) max_n <- max(county_sf$n, na.rm = TRUE) bins <- unique(c(1, 5, 20, 100, 500, max_n + 1)[c(1, 5, 20, 100, 500, max_n + 1) <= max_n + 1]) pal <- colorBin("YlOrRd", county_sf$n_map, bins = bins, na.color = "transparent") leaflet(county_sf) |> addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |> addPolygons( fillColor = ~pal(n_map), fillOpacity = 0.75, color = "#999", weight = 0.4, popup = ~label, label = ~paste0(county, ": ", n) ) |> addLegend(pal = pal, values = ~n_map, title = "Arrests", position = "bottomright") } else { knitr::kable( d$landmark_counts |> head(30) |> rename(`Arrest location` = apprehension_site_landmark, N = n, `%` = pct), caption = paste0( "Top arrest locations (county data available for only ", round(county_coverage * 100, 0), "% of arrests)" ) ) } ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: Top arrest locations (county data available for only 14% of arrests) |Arrest location | N| %| |:-----------------------------------------|---:|----:| |SFD GENERAL AREA, NON-SPECIFIC | 145| 24.0| |MINNEHAHA CO JAIL, SIOUX FALLS, SD | 99| 16.4| |PENNINGTON COUNTY JAIL, RAPID CITY, SD | 67| 11.1| |RPC GENERAL AREA, NON-SPECIFIC | 46| 7.6| |BEADLE CO REGIONAL CORR. CENT., HURON, SD | 37| 6.1| |DAVISON CO JAIL, MITCHELL, SD | 36| 6.0| |BROOKINGS CO JAIL, BROOKINGS, SD | 25| 4.1| |CODINGTON CO DET CENT, WATERTOWN, SD | 22| 3.6| |RAPID CITY, SOUTH DAKOTA | 15| 2.5| |SD STATE PRISON, SIOUX FALLS, SD | 15| 2.5| |MEADE COUNTY JAIL, STURGIS, SD | 14| 2.3| |BROWN CO JAIL, ABERDEEN, SD | 11| 1.8| |SFD ICE OFFICE, SIOUX FALLS, SD | 11| 1.8| |US MARSHAL SERVICE, SIOUX FALLS, SD | 9| 1.5| |YANKTON CITY JAIL, YANKTON, SD | 8| 1.3| |HUGHES CO JAIL, PIERRE, SD | 6| 1.0| |US MARSHAL SERVICE, RAPID CITY, SD | 6| 1.0| |LAKE CO JAIL, MADISON, SD | 4| 0.7| |GRANT CO MILBANK DET CENTR, MILBANK, SD | 3| 0.5| |LAWRENCE COUNTY JAIL, DEADWOOD, SD | 3| 0.5| |SXC GENERAL AREA, NON-SPECIFIC | 3| 0.5| |UNION CO JAIL, ELK POINT, SD | 3| 0.5| |FALL RIVER COUNTY JAIL, HOT SPRINGS, SD | 2| 0.3| |TRIPP CO JAIL, WINNER, SD | 2| 0.3| |XOF GENERAL AREA, NON-SPECIFIC | 2| 0.3| |BELL FOURCHE, SOUTH DAKOTA | 1| 0.2| |CHARLES MIX CO JAIL, LAKE ANDES, SD | 1| 0.2| |FAULK CO JAIL, FAULKTON, SD | 1| 0.2| |HILL CITY, SOUTH DAKOTA | 1| 0.2| |ROBERTS CO JAIL, SISSETON, SD | 1| 0.2| ::: ::: > **Coverage:** 14% of arrests mapped to a county. --- ## Detention Facility Maps and Transfer Flows ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} flows <- d$flow_arrows .bearing <- function(lon1, lat1, lon2, lat2) { dlon <- (lon2 - lon1) * pi / 180 lat1r <- lat1 * pi / 180; lat2r <- lat2 * pi / 180 y <- sin(dlon) * cos(lat2r) x <- cos(lat1r) * sin(lat2r) - sin(lat1r) * cos(lat2r) * cos(dlon) (atan2(y, x) * 180 / pi + 360) %% 360 } rad <- function(n) pmax(3, log10(n + 1) * 8.4) base_map <- leaflet() |> addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) if (nrow(flows) > 0) { lines_geom <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(flows)), function(i) { st_linestring(matrix(c(flows$from_lon[i], flows$from_lat[i], flows$to_lon[i], flows$to_lat[i]), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)) }) flows_sf <- st_sf(flows, geometry = st_sfc(lines_geom, crs = 4326)) base_map <- base_map |> addPolylines(data = flows_sf, weight = ~weight, color = "#555", opacity = 0.5, popup = ~label, group = "Transfer flows") } first_popup <- paste0("", d$first_fac$canonical_name, "
", d$first_fac$facility_city, ", ", d$first_fac$facility_state, "
First facility for ", format(d$first_fac$n, big.mark=","), " arrests") last_popup <- paste0("", d$last_fac$canonical_name, "
", d$last_fac$facility_city, ", ", d$last_fac$facility_state, "
Final facility for ", format(d$last_fac$n, big.mark=","), " arrests") base_map |> addCircleMarkers(data = d$first_fac, lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat, radius = ~rad(n), color = "#1a6bb5", fillColor = "#4a90d9", fillOpacity = 0.75, weight = 1.2, popup = first_popup, group = "First detention facility") |> addCircleMarkers(data = d$last_fac, lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat, radius = ~rad(n), color = "#a03000", fillColor = "#d94a1a", fillOpacity = 0.75, weight = 1.2, popup = last_popup, group = "Last detention facility") |> addLayersControl( overlayGroups = c("Transfer flows", "First detention facility", "Last detention facility"), options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE) ) |> hideGroup("Transfer flows") |> setView(lng = -96, lat = 38, zoom = 4) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: **First detention facility (top 8):** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} d$first_fac |> mutate(pct = round(n / d$n_stays * 100, 1)) |> select(code, canonical_name, facility_city, facility_state, n, pct) |> head(8) |> rename(DETLOC = code, Facility = canonical_name, City = facility_city, State = facility_state, N = n, `%` = pct) |> kable() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} |DETLOC |Facility |City |State | N| %| |:-------|:-------------------------------------|:-----------|:-----|---:|----:| |MINNESD |Minnehaha County Jail |Sioux Falls |SD | 307| 49.4| |RPCHOLD |Rapid City Hold Room |Rapid City |SD | 110| 17.7| |SFDHOLD |Sioux Falls Hold Room |Sioux Falls |SD | 107| 17.2| |PENNISD |Pennington County Jail (South Dakota) |Rapid City |SD | 49| 7.9| |WOODBIA |Woodbury County Jail |Sioux City |IA | 20| 3.2| |KANDIMN |Kandiyohi County Jail |Willmar |MN | 13| 2.1| |EROFCB |Camp East Montana |El Paso |TX | 3| 0.5| |PIC |Port Isabel Detention Center |Los Fresnos |TX | 3| 0.5| ::: ::: --- ## Removal Pipeline Flow ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} geo_lookup_names <- bind_rows( d$first_fac |> select(code, name = canonical_name), d$last_fac |> select(code, name = canonical_name) ) |> distinct(code, .keep_all = TRUE) short_name <- function(code) { nm <- geo_lookup_names$name[match(code, geo_lookup_names$code)] ifelse(is.na(nm), code, paste0(code, "\n(", str_trunc(nm, 22, ellipsis = "…"), ")")) } san <- d$sankey_data |> mutate( first_disp = if_else(first_label == "Other", "Other", short_name(first_label)), last_disp = if_else(last_label == "Other", "Other", short_name(last_label)), outcome_fct = factor(outcome_label, levels = c("Removed", "Released", "Pending / Unknown")) ) ggplot(san, aes(y = n, axis1 = stage1, axis2 = first_disp, axis3 = last_disp, axis4 = outcome_fct)) + geom_alluvium(aes(fill = outcome_fct), alpha = 0.65, width = 1/6) + geom_stratum(fill = "grey92", color = "grey60", width = 1/6) + geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum)), size = 2.8, lineheight = 0.9) + scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Arrest", "First facility", "Last facility", "Outcome"), expand = c(0.08, 0.08)) + scale_fill_manual(values = c("Removed" = "#c0392b", "Released" = "#2980b9", "Pending / Unknown" = "#95a5a6")) + scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) + labs(y = "Number of stays", fill = "Outcome", title = paste(state_full, "arrest → detention → outcome pipeline")) + theme_minimal(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.major = element_blank()) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning in to_lodes_form(data = data, axes = axis_ind, discern = params$discern): Some strata appear at multiple axes. Removal Destinations ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} top_dest <- d$removal_heatmap |> group_by(departure_country) |> summarise(total = sum(n), .groups = "drop") |> slice_max(total, n = 15) |> arrange(desc(total)) |> pull(departure_country) top_cit <- d$removal_heatmap |> group_by(citizenship_country) |> summarise(total = sum(n), .groups = "drop") |> slice_max(total, n = 12) |> arrange(desc(total)) |> pull(citizenship_country) hm <- d$removal_heatmap |> filter(departure_country %in% top_dest, citizenship_country %in% top_cit) |> tidyr::complete(departure_country = top_dest, citizenship_country = top_cit, fill = list(n = 0L, row_pct = 0)) |> mutate(departure_country = factor(departure_country, levels = rev(top_dest)), citizenship_country = factor(citizenship_country, levels = top_cit)) ggplot(hm, aes(x = citizenship_country, y = departure_country, fill = row_pct)) + geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) + geom_text(aes(label = if_else(n > 0L, format(n, big.mark = ","), "")), size = 3, color = "black") + scale_fill_gradient(low = "#fff5f0", high = "#a50f15", name = "% of row", limits = c(0, 100), na.value = "grey95") + scale_x_discrete(position = "top") + labs(x = "Citizenship country", y = "Deported to", title = paste("Citizenship vs. removal destination —", state_full)) + theme_minimal(base_size = 11) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 0, size = 9), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9), panel.grid = element_blank()) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](sd_files/figure-html/removal-heatmap-1.png){width=1152} ::: ::: --- ##
